power.jaymospowers.zfighter.key.ability_: Charge Ki (hold): the aura flares and ki pours in (1 per tick) while you slow to a crawl; hungry work. Your heart's heat (on the action bar) fills as you run, land from a height and are hurt, more slowly the better you master this form; full, it boils over in a surge that hits everyone near you, friend or foe. Sprint + %1$s: Cone Burst, a punched wave of air and heat 6 blocks ahead (8 heat or more). Tap sneak + %1$s: the dial, how much of the heat each move pours in (a quarter, a half, all of it); the more it spends, the harder it hits
Charge Ki · Heat

Your quick technique (switch it on the training screen). Sprint + %2$s: Blast Dash, blast off along your look, the blast behind you hurting what stood there. Sneak + %2$s: Recoil, blast what's in front and be thrown backwards (10 heat or more each)
Quick Technique · Blast Dash
